summary: Nunn is a consistent defender of Israel's military posture. In 2023 he wrote that he "will never waver" on Israel support and co-led a House resolution calling for immediate U.S. intelligence, diplomatic, and military support for Israel; in October 2024 he demanded "unwavering U.S. support for Israel's right to defend itself," citing Iron Dome replenishment. He also voted Yea on H.R. 6090, directing use of the IHRA definition in education-discrimination enforcement. His only documented reference to Gaza concerns evacuating Americans.
